title: Everest Isn't the Highest Point on Earth
hook: Everest has been getting credit that belongs to two other mountains.
closing: Highest depends on where you start measuring, so check the starting line before you trust a record.
question: Which mountain is the real winner?

segments.say: Everest, at 8,849 meters, tops every list because we measure from sea level. Change the starting line, and the winner changes.
Measured from the seafloor, Mauna Kea is 10,211 meters tall. Most of it hides underwater, so sea level hides its true size.
Measure from Earth's center, and Chimborazo sticks out 13.4 kilometers past a round Earth, farther than Everest. Same mountains, different winner.
